title: Safety Training Modulates Harmful Misalignment Under On-Policy RL, But Direction Depends on Environment Design
reasoning: The study benchmarks Large Language Models (LLMs) on harmful misalignment using the Machiavelli ethics benchmark and creates custom environments (Therapy Talk, Action Advice) to evaluate moral dilemmas such as whether a model will encourage a user to engage in harmful behaviors like substance abuse. It also evaluates political sycophancy and ideological entrenchment.
